name: Kanatsune Ame
source:
An adult with an eclectic sense of style and a willingness to do whatever he needs for success.

Kanatsun is one of three playable protagonists in Entropic Float. His role is that of the 'over-informed', the one character who has more information than all of the others. Unfortunately, this information won't quite prove to be enough...
